Biology 2016-II.question: Which one of the following is most sensitive to environmental change?
Biology 2016-II.explanation: (a)  Environmental changes affecting all regions the world and influence all organisms. Amphibians are one Biology 58 of the most sensitive groups to change, whether that is caused by habitat loss, invasive species, disease, trade or climate change. Nearly 33% of the amphibian species of the world are categorized as threatened on the Red List. Furthermore, given their complex life cycles and other traits, amphibians are often recognized as indicators of ecosystem health.

Biology 2016-II.question: Which one of the following air pollutants combines with the haemoglobin of human blood and reduces its oxygen- carrying capacity, leading to suffocation and may cause even death?
Biology 2016-II.explanation: (c)  Carbon monoxide (CO)  has strong affinity to combine/ bind with haemoglobin in blood to form carboxyhaemoglobin, which reduces oxygen carrying capacity of blood to cause headache, nausea, asphyxiation and fainting (low supply of O2 to body though one may inhale normally). Against normal level of 0.5% CO in blood, severe pollution may lead to 8 to 9% CO.

Biology 2016-II.question: Deficiency of fluoride leads to which one of the following health problems?
Biology 2016-II.explanation: (a)  Fluorine deficiency is a disorder which may cause increased dental caries (or tooth decay, is the breakdown of dental tissues by the acidic products released by the "bacterial fermentation of dietary carbohydrates.") and possibly osteoporosis (a bone disorder which leads to a decrease in bone mass, and an increase in bone fragility), due to a lack of fluoride in the diet.

Biology 2016-II.question: Which one of the following statements is not correct?
options: The response of the ear to sound of increasing intensity is approximately logarithmic.
The sensitivity of the human ear does not vary with the frequency of the sound.
When two or more waves traverse the same medium, the displacement of any element of the medium is the algebraic sum of the displacements due to each wave.
Longitudinal waves can travel in all media-solids, liquids and gases.
Biology 2016-II.answer: The sensitivity of the human ear does not vary with the frequency of the sound.
Biology 2016-II.explanation: (b)  The human ear can respond to minute pressure variations in the air if they are in the audible frequency range, roughly 20 Hz - 20 kHz.

Biology 2016-II.question: Which one of the following hormones is essential for the uptake of glucose by cells in the human body?
Biology 2016-II.explanation: (c)  Insulin is a hormone made by the pancreas that allows your body to use sugar (glucose) from carbohydrates in the food that you eat for energy or to store glucose for future use. Insulin helps keeps your blood sugar level from getting too high (hyperglycemia) or too low (hypoglycemia).
